data.name: Variant Channeling - Knowledge
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on Knowledge and Perception checks until the end of your next turn. Harm - Sentient creatures (Intelligence 3+) who fail their saves take 1d2 points of Intelligence damage. A successful save negates this Intelligence damage.|ChannelModifier
